Original translation by Erokawa Senpai and Sora. Editing by Sora and Venator. Typesetting and dCleaning by Erokawa_senpai. Proofreading / QC by Sora, Cure, Blanny, and Wenneko. I'm not affiliated with anyone here.

This is my first gallery upload - let me know if there's any problems. This doujin is bizarrely difficult to find english translations for but is pretty good, so I wanted to upload the full series. Erokawa Senpai and co appear to have an incomplete translation for 5 of 8 chapters, so I plan to upload them + edited MTL versions of the missing ones soon.
